info.description: Static, read-only JSON: 30-year NPV for U.S. colleges (positive-NPV envelope), lifetime ROI for every bachelor's major category and subfield, and the standing rankings. Dataset DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21351602. Methodology: https://le-teen.com/methodology.
